limitations: Static geometric ambient visibility approximation, not Cycles GI or indirect light baking.
Only architecture and summer interior opaque geometry occlude; plants, terrain and glazing are excluded.
The finite 8m radius and 24 rays approximate occluded sky; no interreflected light, bent normals or color bleeding.
Original vertex density is unchanged, so interpolation on large source triangles cannot reproduce per-pixel contact shadows.
Valid only for the exact source hashes and assembled transforms; disable during exploded views.
